loadingShellRootCause: Public book and audiobook detail routes loaded only summary metadata on the server. MorseBookPage then started in status=loading until the small local /book-previews/{slug}.preview.json request resolved on the client, so valid preview-backed pages briefly rendered the full-page loading hero and Loading book text panel before starter content.
implementationSummary: Public book and audiobook loaders now fetch the small local startup preview asset and pass it as initial preview runtime content when available.
MorseBookPage initializes in preview mode from that route-provided starter content instead of resetting to the full loading shell.
The full book JSON still loads in the background and still falls back to the starter preview if the full payload is unavailable or malformed.
Tests now assert no full loading shell, no Loading book text panel, visible starter content, route counts, summary placement, mobile overflow, and failed full-JSON fallback.
fullPayloadRequestBehavior: Focused Playwright coverage verifies one full book JSON request for deferred public book hydration when full text is needed. The route-provided startup preview avoids the extra browser-side preview fetch.
desktopLayoutShiftResult: Focused route coverage verifies the real page workspace is present immediately and desktop width does not overflow; no full-page loading shell is inserted before starter content.
mobileOverflowResult: Focused route coverage verifies the requested routes at 390px have no horizontal overflow.
summaryPlacementResult: Focused route coverage verifies #book-summary remains after Source notes for the requested routes.
audiobookBehaviorResult: Audiobook routes now receive the same route-provided starter preview runtime content; the live player renders immediately without the full loading shell while full book JSON hydrates in the background.
